operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Item (5) of EO 11248 sec. 1 (level IV) is terminated: EO 11708 sec. 3 revokes EO 11248 as amended 'Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2 of this order' (the level V list, which does not include item (5)). The signing date, March 23, 1973 ('The White House, March 23, 1973' at the foot of the order in 38 FR 7980), is the effective date because the order contains no effective-date or delay wording; the date is not taken from any marginal note or computation. Standing placement, not a spent command; no earlier end found: Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1970 redesignates the Bureau as OMB without abolishing it, and EO 11540's substitution of 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget' (effective 1970-07-01) retitles and widens the item, recorded as a later event. The quote on the end record is the sec. 3 sentence.

later_events.mechanism: amendment: substitutes 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President' for the words of item (5), effective July 1, 1970 by the order's own sentence; a conforming retitle after Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1970 redesignated the Bureau of the Budget, not an ending of the placement

This order shall be effective July 1, 1970.

become effective upon publication in the 
F ederal  R egister .

1306, Albuquerque, N. Mex. 87103.

cordance with all applicable State regu­

research_rationale:
EO 11367 (signed 1967-08-18, 32 FR 12037; held official Federal Register text read in full) adds item (5), 'Assistant Director for Executive Management, Bureau of the Budget, Executive Office of the President', to section 1 (level IV) of EO 11248. It has one operative sentence, a standing pay-level designation under 5 U.S.C. 5317, with no term or condition. The rest of the held extract (migratory-bird and other regulations on the same pages) is neighbouring material, not part of the order. Newly held: Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1970 (84 Stat. 2085-2086, read in full). Sec. 102(a) provides 'The Bureau of the Budget in the Executive Office of the President is hereby designated as the Office of Management and Budget'; sec. 102(b) designates the statutory Assistant Directors (31 U.S.C. 16a, 16c) Assistant Directors of OMB; sec. 103 makes the Bureau's records, property and personnel OMB's. That is a redesignation of the same entity and offices, so it abolishes nothing and is not an end. The Statutes at Large marginal note gives 'Effective July 1, 1970' for the plan, and sec. 301 sets July 1, 1970 as the floor; no end date in this claim depends on that note. EO 11540 (signed 1970-07-01, 35 FR 10735; held, read in full) states 'This order shall be effective July 1, 1970' and substitutes, in item (5), 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President' for the words of this order. I treat that as a conforming retitle, recorded as a later event and not as the first end: the item keeps its number and level IV, and the substituted title covers every OMB Assistant Director, including any post that was the former Assistant Director for Executive Management, so the placement was widened and renamed, not withdrawn. The dossier has no OMB organization record (the request was answered with the plan only); the judgment does not need one because the retitled item has a live object under sec. 102(b). The first end is EO 11708 (signed 1973-03-23, 38 FR 7979; held, read in full), sec. 3: 'Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2 of this order, Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, is hereby revoked.' EO 11708 states no effective date or delay, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1973-03-23. Sec. 2 continues only eight level V positions, none of them OMB, so item (5) (level IV) is revoked; sec. 1(9) of EO 11708 places 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget' in level IV under its own authority, a new placement and not a residue of this order. The three machine searches (U.S. Code release 119-121 and eCFR as of 2026-10-14: 0 hits; OFR disposition catalog: hits read, all EO 11540/11708) carry no coverage warning. A reviewer should test (a) whether EO 11540's substitution should be the first end instead (1970-07-01), and (b) whether the revocation date 1973-03-23 is right given EO 11708 has no effective-date wording.

(b) EO 11540 (held, effective July 1, 1970 by its own sentence): retitles item (5); treated as a later event, not an end, for the coverage reason given in the rationale. (c) I read the operative paragraphs of every other amender of EO 11248 issued after 1967-08-18 (EO 11369, 11384, 11385, 11389, 11393, 11400, 11409, 11416, 11421, 11441, 11463, 11468, 11489, 11499, 11504, 11510, 11516, 11542, 11550, 11581, 11587, 11604, 11634, 11641, 11676, 11699). The only continuing effect is the level IV designation under 5 U.S.C. 5317. It imposes no duty on any officer, no report, no fixed term and no condition, and it is a standing designation, not a performed command, so it lasted until altered or revoked. No independent command survives the revocation.","savings_check":"Searched EO 11708 secs. 1-3 and EO 11540 for saving wording as stated in the savings reason: none for item (5). Transferred or accrued effects: none; the level IV placement of the OMB Assistant Director is re-made by EO 11708 sec. 1(9) under that order's own authority, which is that order's provision, not a residue of EO 11367.","scope_check":"The first end is the revocation of the parent order EO 11248 as amended; the machine record marks scope 'partial' because of the exception for the sec. 2 positions. I read sec. 2 of EO 11708: it continues eight level V positions (Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense (Comptroller); Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for Reserve Affairs; Assistant Secretary, Comptroller, HEW; Deputy Commissioner of Social Security; Commissioner on Aging; Deputy Director, Secret Service; Commissioner, Property Management and Disposal Service, GSA; Deputy Assistant Secretary for Model Cities, HUD). None is item (5), and item (5) is a section 1 (level IV) item while sec. 2 continues only level V positions, so the revocation reaches this clause in full. The whole order is this one item, so the whole-order end is the clause end."}

savings_residuals.reason: Read EO 11708 secs. 1-3 and EO 11540 in full for saving, transition or incumbent-protection wording about item (5): none. EO 11708 sec. 3's only exception is the sec. 2 list of eight level V positions. EO 11367 created no office, fund, duty or vested right; it only designated a pay level for an existing office, and pay received while it stood is a completed consequence. EO 11708 sec. 1(9) re-places the OMB Assistant Director in level IV under its own authority, so no independent residual of EO 11367 remains.
